description: Overdraft fees, late fees, failed-payment charges and higher unit costs apply precisely when there is least money, by design of the product rather than by anyone's decision.
energy_note: A charge that only exists when you cannot pay it.

aspect: Buying small costs more per unit
description: Sachet economics: the smallest quantity has the highest unit price, so the people with least cash pay the most per gram.
energy_note: Charged more per gram for having less cash.

aspect: There is nobody to appeal to
description: The charge is correct under the terms, applied by a system, and the call handler has no authority to reverse it beyond a goodwill limit that runs out.
